purpose: Select a small prompt change for short English-to-Japanese inputs without another model, dictionary, or resident process.

setup.request_isolation: Clear KV and reset sampler before every request; one resident model; variants interleaved per case.

design.selection: Fixed using development output only, before inspecting heldout output. No prompt tuning after heldout review.
design.review: One delegated evaluator graded deduplicated outputs with variant identities hidden. Parent inspected outputs and selected implementation. These are AI semantic assessments, not human annotations or a standardized benchmark.
design.additional_selection_constraint: Avoid replacing the original reported opaque transliteration of serendipitous with an unrelated confident meaning.

rubric.2: Meaning preserved and natural enough to use; style and punctuation differences ignored.
rubric.1: Partly useful but meaning incomplete or an opaque borrowed term obscures the ordinary meaning. Established loanwords and names are allowed.
rubric.0: Wrong meaning, literal idiom translation, or untranslated input.
